name: CERN QTI Online Lecture Series
description: The CERN Quantum Technology Initiative runs a free online lecture series covering quantum theory, simulation, sensing, computing, algorithms, and quantum networks. Lectures are delivered by early-career and senior researchers and recorded for on-demand viewing on the CERN QTI website and the CERN Lectures YouTube channel. The series began in March 2023 and continues on a regular weekly schedule.
